# canireplaceit.com

> Around 590 paid SaaS products mapped to open source and cheaper replacements.
> Licence, self-hosting, open-core status, the SSO tax and repo health for each
> one, and every price carries the date a human last checked it. English and
> French. Data is CC-BY-4.0, attribution required.

This file is written for coding agents, which are the tools that actually read
it. If you are one, start with the skill or the API rather than the pages.

If you quote us, link the page. The check dates are the part that makes the
answer defensible, so keep them.

Most pages have a Markdown twin: the same URL with `.md` appended. Every page
that has one says so in its own head, with a
`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">` tag, and the standing pages that
render live figures or static legal copy have none.

## For agents

- [Skill](https://canireplaceit.com/skill.md): how to query this catalogue, what the words mean, how to rank an answer
- [API](https://canireplaceit.com/api/v1): no key, 60 requests per minute, every object carries the URL of its page
- [OpenAPI](https://canireplaceit.com/api/v1/openapi.json): the full contract, response schemas included
- [Whole catalogue](https://canireplaceit.com/api/v1/dump.json): one request instead of five hundred
- [A Markdown twin](https://canireplaceit.com/en/alternatives/notion.md): what appending `.md` to a page URL gets you

## Browse

- [Every product](https://canireplaceit.com/en/): the catalogue itself, paginated
- [Every project](https://canireplaceit.com/en/tools/): the replacements, most-cited first
- [Categories](https://canireplaceit.com/en/categories/): 85 of them, with a product count and a median price each
- [Collections](https://canireplaceit.com/en/collections/): derived slices such as fully open, one compose file, under ten dollars
- [The graveyard](https://canireplaceit.com/en/collections/archived): projects that died
- [Gaps](https://canireplaceit.com/en/gaps): products with no credible replacement yet
- [Glossary](https://canireplaceit.com/en/glossary): what open core, effort and verdict mean here

## Optional

- [Atom feed](https://canireplaceit.com/feed.xml): the 50 most recently re-verified prices
- [In French](https://canireplaceit.com/fr/): the whole catalogue again, localised
- [Sitemap index](https://canireplaceit.com/sitemap.xml): every URL, if you would rather crawl than query
